question: What contemplative attitude must be maintained toward all participants in the Kaula context?
premises: All persons are to be included in contemplation.
Śiva and Gaurī provide the model of awareness.
inference: One should regard all as Śiva and Gaurī and should not show disrespect to anyone.
plain_english: One should regard all with the awareness of Śiva and Gaurī and should not disrespect them.
